stable.label: scratch-organic-navigation-tested
stable.note: The active scratch runtime now hides the environmental grid behind an organic field renderer and uses terrain-aware persistent waypoint navigation. Changed alife/worker code invalidates the previous overall CI promotion until fresh CI passes.

active_experience.runtime: vanilla JavaScript modules + Worker + transferred OffscreenCanvas; no third-party runtime libraries
simulation_changes: the cave/atmosphere/multi-fluid environment and surface ecosystem remain active
ALife goals are converted into persistent terrain-aware surface routes rather than direct target chasing
route cost reads actual slope, water depth, root reinforcement and waterlogged-instability state
deep water and excessive slopes can make a target unreachable; organisms abandon blocked food/water goals instead of vibrating against the obstruction
route look-ahead waypoints persist between replans and steering direction is exponentially damped instead of flipping instantly
locomotion demand ramps toward target speed and slows around steep, flooded or unstable substrate
active cave environment resolution is increased from 24-unit cells/30 rows to 18-unit cells/40 rows
environment cells remain simulation bookkeeping but are no longer drawn as rounded rectangles
cave voids render as overlapping circles/capsules joined from the actual solid/void field
cave water and urine render as connected smooth liquid envelopes derived from actual per-cell liquid mass
clouds render as overlapping continuous translucent fields derived from persistent cloud water
creature render poses are interpolated from authoritative physics nodes so small solver corrections do not appear as visible twitching
approximations: navigation is a terrain-aware side-view surface route planner, not a general 2D/3D navmesh
render-pose interpolation is presentation smoothing and does not change simulation physics
organic cave/liquid rendering smooths the visualization of discrete environmental cells; the underlying environmental solver remains cellular
cave atmosphere remains 2D cellular diffusion/transport rather than gas CFD
cave water/urine remain gravity/lateral cellular transport rather than Navier-Stokes, SPH, FLIP or MPM
surface rivers/ocean remain the separate one-dimensional side-view shallow-water approximation
ALife remains authored drive arbitration with memory and is not learning
creature articulation remains 2D Verlet/distance constraints with authored gait actuation

scratch_alife.note: alife.js changed to route goals through persistent terrain-aware navigation; fresh CI required.

scratch_environment.note: environment core is retained, but active environment-worker/render resolution changed; fresh overall CI required.

prior_failed_attempt.reason: bad transient-cell gravity assertion; corrected to center-of-mass conservation test

scratch_rendering.contract: environment grid is hidden; visual cave/liquid envelopes are derived from simulation fields

legacy_ecosystem_stack.note: Previous V100-V110 and patch layers remain in repository history/files but are not imported by the current route.

active_objective: Run fresh CI for organic cave/liquid rendering and terrain-aware navigation, then exercise the deployed build on iPhone to judge whether the world no longer reads as block cells and whether organisms move without target-chasing jitter.
next_gate: CI_PASS requires fresh Codehood and Foundation evidence covering scratch_navigation.test.mjs, scratch_render.test.mjs and syntax of navigation/organic-render/environment-worker. LIVE_TESTED/DEVICE_TESTED still require deployed browser/iPhone execution.
invariants: Active route must not import archived V100-V110 layers
No third-party runtime libraries in the scratch engine
Rendering must run through transferred OffscreenCanvas in a worker
Simulation cells may not be presented as visible block tiles in the default renderer
Do not call the side-view planner a general 2D/3D navmesh
Do not call render interpolation physics
Do not call cellular gas transport CFD
Do not call the ALife controller learning
Changed runtime invalidates prior overall CI promotion
CI_PASS does not imply LIVE_TESTED or DEVICE_TESTED
